title: Authoritative building-height overrides
description: Heights or floor counts from open data with a traceable source and licence: authoritative (cadastre, LiDAR, official surveys) through --overrides, or third-party (Overture) through --secondary-overrides. An entry with only `levels` is converted with the category storey height.

id.description: An OSM building, or a Catastro sub-building <osm id>:<localId> written by cadastre split (ADR-016)

origin.description: How the source produced the value; overture match writes it from sources[].dataset (ADR-021)
